title: Add shared build settings, CI and a fast test set

There is no CI, no shared build settings and no way to run only the fast tests, so a refactor is checked only when someone remembers to run the full suite locally, and the suite includes runs of thousands of evaluations.
We want a `Directory.Build.props` and `.editorconfig` shared by both projects, warnings as errors, a GitHub Actions workflow, and a trait that separates slow tests.

Its responsibilities are:
* `Directory.Build.props`: target framework, nullable, implicit usings settled one way for both projects, `TreatWarningsAsErrors`, and the language version
* `.editorconfig` with the formatting the code already follows, and `dotnet format --verify-no-changes` passing
* A `Speed` trait: tests that run searches, bounded checks with time limits, or external tools are `slow`; the rest are fast
* A workflow on push and pull request: build, fast tests, then slow tests, on Linux with iverilog installed and Metal, Uppaal and norse tests skipping as they do now

Existing warnings should be fixed, not suppressed, unless a suppression names why in one line, because a suppressed warning list grows.
The fast set should run in under two minutes locally, because it is the set run after every refactoring step.

Where: `SNP_Evolution/SNP_Evolution.csproj`, `SNP_Evolution.Tests/SNP_Evolution.Tests.csproj`, `SNP_Evolution.Tests/Export/ToolFactAttributes.cs`; new `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.

Done when:
- [ ] `dotnet build` passes with warnings as errors
- [ ] `dotnet test --filter Speed!=slow` runs in under two minutes and the workflow runs both sets on push
- [ ] `dotnet format --verify-no-changes` passes
- [ ] `dotnet test` green

Read first: README "How to build"
